candidates.rationale: This statement adds an open mmap reference to the vnode before calling generic_file_mmap_prepare(). If the subsequent prepare fails, there may be improper cleanup or race conditions with vnode lifecycle management, potentially leading to use-after-free or reference counting issues.

This is the critical operation that can fail after afs_add_open_mmap() has been called. If it fails, the error handling must properly clean up the previously added mmap reference, making this a potential source of resource leaks or inconsistent state.

vuln_statements.explanation: This statement adds an open mmap reference to the vnode BEFORE the generic_file_mmap_prepare() call succeeds. If prepare fails, the reference may not be properly cleaned up, leading to reference counting issues or use-after-free when the vnode is freed while still having an active mmap reference.

This is the critical operation that can fail AFTER afs_add_open_mmap() has already incremented the mmap reference count. The error handling path must properly clean up the previously added reference, making this a potential source of resource leaks or inconsistent cb_nr_mmap counter state between mmap operations and callback breaking.
